title: assign_devid / assign_devid_ssl are near-duplicate code, rollback logic in two places
description: wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid (port.c:1520) and wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid_ssl (port.c:1547) differ only in wolfSSL_CTX_SetDevId vs wolfSSL_SetDevId. All surrounding logic (save/restore g_tls_safe_mode, RegisterDevice, rollback on SetDevId failure) is duplicated. The P0 rollback bug (wolfssl-lc7.2) must be fixed in both functions. Suggested rewrite: extract a static helper crypto2dev_assign_devid_internal(set_devid_fn, void* obj) and call it from both public functions.
